_doc: tools/import_rank_art.gd reads this: the AI-drawn rank art (PROMPTS.md here) → assets/ranks/frame_<grade>.png + badge_<grade>.png + ranks.json. Sources: frames/frame_<grade>.png, badges/badge_<grade>.png (flat magenta backdrop, keyed from the corners), or a cell of a sheet (sheets: file, kind frame|badge, cols, rows, grades row-major, "" = empty cell; a single file wins over its cell). groups: the art group of every grade id (art only: the names and the order are the game data's). frame: the shipped canvas size (px), window [x0, y0, x1, y1] (fractions of the canvas: the transparent opening the card fills, = ui/art.gd RANK_FRAME_INSET each side), windowRadius (fraction of the canvas width: the opening's corner radius, used by forceWindow), seat {centre [fx, fy], radius (fraction of the width)}: the plain medallion the game draws the badge on, stretchX / stretchY (fractions: the plain band runs a wider / taller card stretches; the art must be uniform there, the tool measures it; stretchX is empty: every card is narrower than the 4:5 opening, so only the side bands stretch and the top / bottom margins are free for crests, rays and wings), stretchTolerance (warn above this mean difference), measureX / measureY (fractions: the columns / rows the opening's edges are measured on: plain band clear of the seat and the bottom emblem, and the side stretch runs), background (tools/import_frames.gd key_background() options), minIsland (opaque specks smaller than this many source px are dropped), watermarkBox (the bottom-right box, fraction of the picture, where a small separate piece is the AI ✦ and is dropped), watermarkMaxArea (fraction of the picture's area: bigger pieces there are art). badge: size, margin (px), fill per group (fraction of size − 2 × margin the badge's longer side fills: the silhouette grows with the group), background, minIsland. glow {group: key_background glow options} when a group's light is painted soft into the backdrop. files {frame_<grade> | badge_<grade>: per picture: watermarks [{centre [x, y], size [rx, ry]}] in source px (a ✦ over the art: rebuilt from the px round it), window [x0, y0, x1, y1] source px (when the opening cannot be measured), forceWindow true (clear everything inside the opening), mirror "left" | "right" (copy that half onto the other, for a frame drawn lopsided)}. See the tool's header and assets/README.md.
